title: Dumbo Octopus
description: Simulate flashing octopuses on a grid with cascade effects.
writeup:
## Approach

A cellular automaton with cascade flashing. Each step: increment all energy levels, then any octopus above 9 flashes and boosts its 8 neighbors, potentially triggering more flashes.

## Part 1

Simulate 100 steps. Each step: increment all cells, BFS-cascade flashes (each octopus flashes at most once per step), then reset flashed cells to 0. Count total flashes across all steps.

## Part 2

Continue stepping until all 100 octopuses flash simultaneously in a single step. This happens when the flash count equals the grid size. The answer is the step number.
